event.distribution_pattern: Products are mostly distributed to stores in NY, CA, NJ, MD . Products were exclusively distributed to H mart stores. Rice Pop Snack is private brand for H Mart.

products.product_description: HAIOREUM, RICE POP SNACK, KOREAN STYLE SNACK 0.41 LBS (190 G)
products.reason_for_recall: The firm, Grand Supercenter Inc., was notified by USFDA NY District Office that they received a report from a consumer in which there was an allergy reaction after the person consumed Haioreum Rice Pop Snack. The firm Grand Supercenter Inc. has decided to recall the product involved in this incident due to Undeclared Wheat allergen.
